Table 002 (Non-Fuel Product Data) product categories are authorizer-specific; a documented list applies to WEX OTR transactions (e.g., ADD, ANFR, BRAK, ... WWFL); other authorizers' category lists are not enumerated in this section

Table 004 (Prompt Data) prompt tokens are authorizer-specific and independently cataloged for Voyager EMV (DF-tag-based), Visa Fleet 2.0, Comdata, WEX OTR, and Conexxus (numeric prompt codes, used by MasterCard Enhanced Fleet EMV); full enumeration of all prompt-token tables is out of scope for this rule catalog pass
Segment Type fixed 146, Segment Length includes Segment Type's length; both Device-sourced (despite this being a response segment, mirroring the sourcing pattern already flagged for Segments 131/136)

Enhanced Fleet Data (Element 239) is required, max 999 characters, cataloged as: Table 001 (Response Flags, incl. Settlement Indicator: CP/DB/DF/RC/RF/FN), Table 002 (Non-Fuel Product Limits, NOT present in Comdata responses), Table 003 (Fuel Product Limits, using Appendix F product codes), Table 004 (Prompt Formats, using documented edit masks), Table 005 (Customer Information: name/city/state/account code), Table 010 (Additional Response Data: FNAM/LNAM/ATHN/ACCT/DMSG)

Table 004 (Prompt Formats) uses a documented edit-mask grammar: '?' (re-prompt), 'A'/'B' (alphanumeric, treated identically since 2015-01-02), 'N' (numeric only), 'I' (free format), 'O' (optional response), 'Z' (capture but don't resend), 'T' (data type N=Number/S=String), 'Mn'/'Xn' (min/max), 'Vn' (exact match), 'Pn' (pattern match using @ /# /* /literal)
Table 003 (Fuel Product Limits) uses standard product codes from ATL105 Appendix F (Valid Payment Systems Product Codes) — unlike Table 002's non-fuel category codes
Segment Type fixed 148, Segment Length includes Segment Type's length; both Host-sourced

Available Product Information (Element 240) is a fixed-format 17-character sub-structure: Restriction Code (2-3 AN, fuel product group codes 00/01/06/07/08/10/11/12/13), '=' filler, Restriction Code Amount (1-5 AN), ',' filler, Restriction Code Quantity (1-5 AN), space filler, Restriction Code Unit of Measure (1 AN)
Segment Type fixed 149, Segment Length 3 digits, Terminal Identifier (var.), Price Data (var., pipe-delimited tag:value pairs e.g. 'CASS:03.00') all Device-sourced
Segment Type fixed 150, Segment Length 3 digits, Terminal Identifier (echo), Decline Code (Element 26, 2 characters, indicates success or failure); all Device-sourced
Segment Type fixed 151, sourced at Host (despite the segment overall 'originating at the device' per the opening statement) — a sourcing inconsistency
Segment Type fixed 152, Segment Length 4 digits, both Host-sourced
Segment Type fixed 153, Segment Length 3 digits (includes Segment Type's length), both Device-sourced

Network Token Data (Element 239) is required, max 999 characters, cataloged as 6 fixed sub-tables: 001 (Network Token, 013-018 bytes), 002 (Expiration Date, fixed 004), 003 (Provisional Fee Indicator, fixed 001), 004 (Input Indicator, fixed 001), 005 (Eligible Indicator, fixed 001), 006 (PAN Indicator, fixed 001)
Segment Type fixed 155; the field table for fields 1-2 does not list a Source (unlike every other segment trained), an editorial omission
Segment 157 does not allow any product codes above '899' except for '955' (Cash Back); if any other code above 899 is present, the transaction will be declined

The total of Adjusted Product Amounts in the segment must equal the total of Element 41 (Fuel Purchase Amount) + Element 58 (Nonfuel Amount) + Element 99 (Tax Amount) + Element 17 (Cash Amount) in Segment 100

Segment Type fixed 157, Segment Length 3 digits, Service Level (Element 87), Number of Products (Element 62, 2 digits), then per-product: Product Code (77, max 3 including 899-cap/955-exception), Unit of Measure (106), Quantity (81, 9 digits, must encode assumed decimal places as whole digits, e.g. 0.05 with 2 decimals = '205'), Unit Price (107, 9 digits, same decimal-encoding rule), Product Amount (76, 12 digits)

Segment DL1 uses NO Field Separators; instead it is self-delimited by a Data Type Indicator ('#', field 1) and an End-of-Data Indicator ('~', last field) — a distinct delimiting convention from the numbered segments (85/84 Segment Type/Length pair)
Merchant Name(53,24), Store Number(98,16), Address Line 1(3,24), Address Line 2(4,21), Merchant Phone Number(54,13) are all required, Host-sourced fixed-length fields
Number of Card Types (Element 59) identifies how many times field 8 (Card Type) repeats — Card Type may repeat 01-99 times
A Card Type value of '173' in this segment's repeating Card Type field (Element 14) conditionally triggers Segment DL6 (Store and Forward) in the same Table Load Response

Each repeated Card Type (Element 14) must be a valid Appendix E 'Card Type Code Used in the Table Load Response': an accepted card type or a device feature code (for example 127, 148, 150, 162-168, 171, 173, 174); feature codes are never used in Prompt Codes
Address Line 2 (Element 4, 21 characters) is positional: positions 1-12 city, 13 space, 14-15 alphabetic State Code (Appendix D), 16 space, 17-21 ZIP Code

Merchant Phone Number (Element 54) is 13 characters in the form (nnn)nnn-nnnn; Store Number (Element 98) is numeric in the range 0000000000000001-9999999999999999 and, when masked with asterisks, is neither displayed nor printed

Dial String Type is fixed value 1; Primary Phone Number block (fields 3-7: Redial Count, Access Code [conditional], Pause Indicator [conditional, fixed 'B'], Phone Number, Dial String Terminator fixed 'A') is required

If Access Code (Element 1) is not necessary, the dial string contains neither the Access Code nor the Pause Indicator (Element 66) that immediately follows it; the Access Code may itself contain one or more 'B' characters, each interpreted as a one-second pause
Redial Count (Element 82) is one digit with valid values 1-3 in both the primary and the secondary block

Phone Number (Element 75) is numeric, variable length up to 18 digits; Dial String Type (Element 28) is fixed '1' (transaction dial strings); Dial String Terminator (Element 27) is 'A' after the first dial string and 'F' after the second
Segment DL3 maximum length is 23 alphanumeric characters; originates at BUYPASS (Host); Data Type Indicator fixed ':' (field 1), End-of-Data Indicator fixed '~' (last field)
Day of the Week(25,1), Current Date(21,6), Current Time(22,4), Cut Time(23,4) are all required and Host-sourced
Password (Element 65, 6 characters) is the only Device-sourced field in this segment, identifying the end-of-day function's password — every other field in Segment DL3 is Host-sourced

Day of the Week (Element 25) is one digit 0-6 (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday); Current Date (Element 21) is MMDDYY; Current Time (Element 22) and Cut Time (Element 23) are HHMM; Current Time includes time-zone and daylight-saving adjustment
Password (Element 65) is numeric, variable length up to six digits, right-aligned and space-filled when shorter than six, and is matched against the password in the merchant's BUYPASS profile

For devices that use an automatic cut time, the device should start the settlement procedure 30 minutes before the Cut Time (Element 23) if the clerk has not completed settlement for that business day
Segment DL4 maximum length is 52 alphanumeric characters; originates at BUYPASS (Host); Data Type Indicator fixed '@' (field 1), End-of-Data Indicator fixed '~' (last field)

New Software Version(57,8), Software Terminal Record ID(95,13), Software Load Phone Number(91,18), Software Load Request Date(92,6), Software Load Request Time(93,4), Software Load Type(94,1) are all required, Host-sourced

New Software Version (57) and Software Terminal Record ID (95) are fixed-length AN 8 and AN 13; Software Load Phone Number (91) is AN up to 18; Software Load Request Date (92) is MMDDYY; Software Load Request Time (93) is HHMM; Software Load Type (94) is 'F' (full application load) or 'P' (partial application load)
Segment DL5 maximum length is 64 alphanumeric characters; originates at BUYPASS (Host); Data Type Indicator fixed '$' (field 1), End-of-Data Indicator fixed '~' (last field)

Segment DL5 is structurally identical to Segment DL4 except field 4 is Software Load IP/URL Address (Element 114, 30 characters) instead of DL4's Software Load Phone Number (Element 91, 18 characters)

Software Load IP/URL Address (Element 114) is AN fixed length 30; New Software Version (57) AN 8, Software Terminal Record ID (95) AN 13, Request Date (92) MMDDYY, Request Time (93) HHMM, Software Load Type (94) 'F' or 'P' follow the same rules as in DL4
Segment DL6 is only sent in a Table Load Response when Segment DL1 (Merchant Data Segment) includes a Card Type value of 173 in Data Element No. 14 (Card Type)
Segment DL6 maximum length is 9 alphanumeric characters; originates at BUYPASS (Host); Data Type Indicator fixed '\' (field 1), End-of-Data Indicator fixed '~' (last field)
Start Time and End Time both use Element 166 and format HHMM, defining the window during which store-and-forward processing is blocked
Start Time and End Time (Element 166) are numeric, fixed length four digits HHMM, valid values 0000-2359

Card Type 173 'Enables Store and Forward blocking for a designated range of time each day'; the DL6 Start Time and End Time define that daily recurring window during which the device blocks store-and-forward processing

Segment DL7 is identified by the special character '^' (Data Type Indicator, Element 24) but, UNLIKE Segments DL1-DL6, does NOT use an End-of-Data Indicator; instead it uses a Segment Length Indicator (Element 84) to frame the segment, matching the pattern used by numbered segments (100-157) rather than the DL1-DL6 marker convention

Segment Length Indicator (Element 84) for Segment DL7 is EXCLUSIVE of the Data Type Indicator's length — a distinct counting convention from most numbered segments, which INCLUDE the Segment Type's length in their Segment Length
Download Data (Element 232, max 100 characters) is required, in <tag><len><data> format, with detailed layout defined in Appendix W (Download Data Layout)

Each Download Data entry is Table ID (n3) + Table Length (n3) + Table Data; Appendix W defines Table ID 001 Site Language (Table Length 003, ISO 639-2 language code of the terminal) and Table ID 002 Postal Code (Table Length 013, international postal code of the transmitting device)
Download Data (Element 232) is alphanumeric, variable length up to 100 bytes, and holds 'all or some of the Download Data'

The DL7 Segment Length (Element 84) is three digits — DL7 is not one of the seven segments allowed a four-digit Segment Length — and must equal the length of the segment content after the Data Type Indicator

Data Type Indicator is fixed value '%' (Element 24); Segment Length Indicator (Element 84, 3 digits) is EXCLUSIVE of the Data Type Indicator's length, same hybrid framing convention as Segment DL7 (no End-of-Data Indicator)

Floor Limit Data repeats per RID, for a maximum of 24 RIDs, total variable length up to 624 bytes; each repetition contains RID (233,10, Host-sourced), Stand-in Indicator (234,1, Host-sourced), Floor Limit (235,12, Host-sourced, maximum allowable stand-in value), BUYPASS RID Card Type (236,3, Host-sourced)

RID (Element 233) is AN fixed 10 and must be a valid EMV Registered Application Provider identifier; Stand-in Indicator (Element 234) is N1 with values 1 (No Stand-in), 2 (Domestic only Stand-in), 3 (Domestic & Foreign Stand-in); Floor Limit (Element 235) is N fixed 12, 000000000000-999999999999; BUYPASS RID Card Type (Element 236) is AN fixed 3
The DL8 Segment Length (Element 84) is three digits and must describe a whole number (1-24) of 26-byte Floor Limit Data groups after the Data Type Indicator
